Stage 1 component distributions. The figure uses layer 1 molecular data. (A) Component 1
sample-coordinate distribution. (B) Component 2 sample-coordinate distribution. Facets show
components 1-2 in decomposition order; stored densities summarize sample-coordinate
distributions; fine rugs show sample coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero. Continuous
metadata is shown by fine sample rugs with a perceptually ordered colour and opacity scale. The
analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is cross-sectional; the
estimand is the descriptive distribution of sample coordinates. No component-selection
threshold is applied. This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a biological
coordinate.
